title: THE PULLEY · 21-15-9 · CABLE CHIPPER
vibe: GREEN · 30 MIN · ONE CLOCK, ONE CABLE STACK
why: Cable machine only and 30 minutes. Yesterday's card was pulls and anti-rotation on the minute, so today flips to legs and push on one descending list for time: six cable stations, 21-15-9, low pulley first then high pulley so you change the height twice a round, not six times. Shape is the for-time chipper, not used since 10-20; cable squat, pullthrough and chest work came from today's cable-only research (garagegymreviews cable workouts). Loads in kg, round 1 finds the weight where the last rep is hard.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 5 MIN · ANKLES, KNEES, HIPS
blocks.meta: ONE PASS · Moves Method Day B, then one empty round

items.name: Toe squats
items.detail: x15, sit back on the heels

items.name: Single-leg squat to the bench
items.detail: x6/leg, control down, stand without a push-off

items.name: Shoulder protocol with the empty handle
items.detail: x15 front raise, x15 lateral raise, no load

items.name: One empty round
items.detail: 5 reps of each station with the pin out, learn the pulley heights

blocks.title: FOR TIME · 21-15-9 · CAP 16:00
blocks.meta: ONE PASS · 3 ROUNDS descending · stations 1-4 on the low pulley, 5-6 on the high · rest only when a set breaks

items.name: 1 · Cable front squat, handle at the chest, start 25 kg
items.detail: 21 / 15 / 9 · low pulley, face the stack, sit back against the cable, chest up

items.name: 2 · Cable Romanian deadlift, rope, start 30 kg
items.detail: 21 / 15 / 9 · low pulley, back to the stack, hinge long, rope between the legs

items.name: 3 · Cable reverse lunge, handle at the chest, start 10 kg
items.detail: 21 / 15 / 9 total · low pulley, face the stack, the cable pulls you forward, stay tall

items.name: 4 · Cable biceps curl, straight bar or rope, start 15 kg
5 · Standing cable chest fly, start 10 kg per side
items.detail: 21 / 15 / 9 · high pulley, split stance, arms long, squeeze the handles together at the sternum. WILDCARD: dual stack, one handle in each hand; single stack, one arm at a time

items.name: 6 · Rope triceps pushdown, start 20 kg
items.detail: 21 / 15 / 9 · high pulley, elbows pinned, split the rope at the bottom

blocks.text: GREEN: finished under 13:00, go one plate up on squat and RDL next time, and write the time. YELLOW: 15-12-9. If the pulley height change costs you, do stations 1-4 then 5-6 in every round and do not reorder.

blocks.title: MIDLINE CLOSE · 2 ROUNDS
blocks.meta: 2 ROUNDS · cable and floor · rest 30 s between rounds

items.name: Kneeling cable crunch, rope, 20 kg
items.detail: x12, rope behind the head, round toward the knees, hips still

items.name: Standing pallof press, 10 kg
items.detail: x10/side, press out and hold 2 s, hips square

items.name: Superhero hold
items.detail: 30 s, arms and legs long, squeeze the glutes

blocks.title: COOLDOWN · 2 MIN
blocks.meta: walk 1:00, then couch stretch 30 s/side on the bench
blocks.text: Record: chipper time, kg settled per station, RPE. Still owed: Tuesday's cable loads if you did it.
